data_manifest.return7_label_rule: Train: day+7 < train_end. Evaluation: day+7 <= max observed day; labels use future only for scoring, never inputs.
data_manifest.ordering: Each target of a user-day has identical context containing earlier days only; earlier day ties sorted by item_id.

sft_selection.criterion: RM-validation user-macro NDCG@10; first prespecified seed only

selection.rule: Maximise user-macro observed-completion weighted hit among recipes with mean validation NDCG >=95% baseline. Same recipe for all seeds; baseline always eligible.
selection.heldout_use: Primary and confirmation predictions not inspected before this file was written.
